new_results: On account03/B02 r47's physical diagonal branch |d|>1/228, exact scalar completion plus the completed sharp D2 half-potential theorem gives a quantitative Schur pair-volume tradeoff: for h=(1+theta)/2, either one orientation has all pair-volume marginals <=h and ||p_Q||inf < 4 sqrt(2e) sqrt(228) (1+theta)^(-1/4)/(1-theta) Z2^(-1/8), or one physical Schur row/column pair carries >theta Z2 of the common incident pair-volume.
At theta=1/2 the diffuse payment is <254.505303 Z2^(-1/8), otherwise one physical Schur row/column anchor carries more than half of all Z2. At theta=0 the bound is <140.828209 Z2^(-1/8).

The adaptive high-ratio concentration threshold sharpens from 16 e^(1/4) to 8 sqrt(2e)=18.6531518528 on the same scalar-Schur scope: T=rho |d|^(1/2) Z2^(1/8)>=8sqrt(2e) forces a common physical row/column inclusion mass >1-8sqrt(2e)/T.

Exact-target family: an isolated unit diagonal pivot plus two normalized k-leaf stars has nonzero spectrum {-1,-1,1,1,1}; after pivoting, the leaf-to-center Schur block has Z2=1 with row marginals 1/k, so ||p_Q||inf<=4sqrt(2e)=9.326575927 uniformly in k and all cap-one product laws.

On that exact-target family every disjoint physical cross block has rank <=2, hence E3=E5=0 for all physical cuts, while every individual nonzero physical 2x2 minor has s2=1/sqrt(k). This is a source-valid obstruction to D'/D5-or-one-good-minor closure, not a QFORM counterexample.
The same exact-target family still has a product-preserving integrated characteristic-function estimate: integral |phi_Q(t)| dt <= pi(1800 e^2)^(1/3)=74.433829332..., hence continuous C0 density.
